replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have a neutral relationship with mathematics. It's not my favorite subject, but I understand its importance, especially in physics, which I enjoy. I can handle basic to intermediate math problems, but advanced topics can be challenging for me.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: I don't get extremely anxious, but I do feel a bit stressed when faced with complex math problems. I prefer to take my time and break them down into simpler parts to understand them better.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I've used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha and Photomath to check my work and understand complex problems. The experience was positive as it helped me grasp concepts more quickly and accurately.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (D = b² - 4ac). Use the quadratic formula (x = [-b ± √(b²-4ac)] / 2a) to find the solutions.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Project the data onto the new subspace formed by the top k eigenvectors.
